title: Fifty-One Ways to Lose a Soccer Game
subtitle: A Season of Mud, Mistakes and Mud Hens
blurb: Dani Ruiz is captain of the Marigold Park Mud Hens, the worst soccer team in the league: eight games, zero wins, fifty-one goals against. She keeps a red notebook of every way they've lost. Then a bus-driving grandmother with a thermos becomes their coach and starts saying a very strange thing: losing is information.
